messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Implemented by three subagents and reviewed against the project rules.

Open **Reproduce a game → Deal name** before exporting. The name returns when you load that snapshot. Existing unnamed saves remain compatible. Pasted saves now load regardless of JSON field order.

Passed: **147 unit tests, 82 browser journeys, type checking and builds**. Changed-file formatting passed; the repository-wide check still reports 53 pre-existing issues in untouched files.
